purpose: The blocked/noticed partition as data. When be-dwell lands attentionClass beside attentionSignal, every kind is tested against this table. The three silent kinds must produce no class at all — absence, not a third value — or the notification center will invent severity from an honest quiet.

rows.why: Control-plane permission prompt: a person is the blocker. Ember fill + OS delivery.
Control-plane wait without naming a permission: still a person-blocker.
Named alternatives handed back: the operator must pick.
Declarative hand-back: the common wait that question-pending is blind to.
Stated assumption inviting correction: silence is consent by omission.
Watcher noticed an idle active lane. Amber outline only — never OS delivery.
We read its closing words and nothing wants you. Absence, not all-clear as a severity.
Ended session: every control disabled. Never a live center item.
Nothing to read is not a correct negative. Blind silence must not look disciplined.
